'''2018 US Nationals Tom Haid LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Haid]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141216/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ Internet Archive]
